# Matt Pocock's skills (bundled)

A pinned copy of the engineering and productivity skills from
[mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), release **v1.3.2**
(commit `d1478fcb140db0b93c0c8df17bcfd311844749d0`), flattened to `<name>/SKILL.md`.
They are Matt Pocock's work under the MIT License in `LICENSE`; KiPo doesn't edit them.

KiPo reads them from here so it works on install with no extra step and can't drift
when upstream renames a skill. To use your own copy instead, set `KIPO_SKILLS_DIR`
(for example `~/.agents/skills`).

To update: copy `skills/engineering/*` and `skills/productivity/*` from a newer
release over this folder, update the version above, run the backend tests, and bump
KiPo's `version` in `app.json`.
